| [home](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:32>) | `function home(){return <div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">WORKBENCH</div><h1>工作台</h1><p>看看项目推进到哪里，以及哪些事需要你。</p></div><button class="primary" data-new-goal>＋ 新目标</button></div><div class="overview-counts"><div><strong>2</strong>项目正在推进</div><div><strong data-inbox-count>${pending()}</strong>项待你处理</div></div><div class="attention-strip"><span>阅读器 · 真机 OCR 待补设备</span><span class="muted">附件检索继续推进</span><a href="${pRoute(project('reader'))}">查看详情 →</a></div><div class="section-head"><h2>项目进展</h2><select id="project-filter" class="filter" aria-label="筛选项目状态"><option value="all">全部项目 · 3</option><option value="active">正在推进 · 2</option><option value="idle">空闲 · 1</option></select></div><div class="table-head"><span>项目</span><span>当前工作</span><span>最近进展</span><span></span></div>${projects.map(projectRow).join('')}<div class="lower-note"><span>批次进度、机器验证和用户试用分别记录。</span><a href="#inbox">查看交付与决策 →</a></div>;}` |
| [projectPage](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:33>) | `function projectPage(p,tab,conversation){return <div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">PROJECT / ${p.id.toUpperCase()}</div><h1>${p.name}</h1><p>${p.description}</p></div><div class="project-controls"><span class="state ${p.active?'':'idle'}">${p.active?'自主推进中':'空闲'}</span><button class="quiet" data-capabilities="${p.id}">项目能力 ↗</button></div></div><nav class="project-tabs" aria-label="项目页面">${[['overview','概览'],['work','工作'],['conversations','对话']].map(([key,label])=><a href="${pRoute(p,key)}" class="${tab===key?'active':''}" ${tab===key?'aria-current="page"':''}>${label}</a>).join('')}</nav>${tab==='conversations'?chat(p,conversation):tab==='work'?work(p):overview(p)};}` |
| [overview](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:34>) | `function overview(p){return <div class="project-layout"><div><section class="section-block"><h3>项目目标</h3><p class="goal-description">${p.goal}</p><p class="muted">${p.note}</p></section><section class="section-block"><div class="section-head"><h2>当前工作</h2><a class="muted" href="${pRoute(p,'work')}">全部工作 →</a></div><div class="work-detail">${requirement(p)}<p class="task-foot">当前阶段：<span data-next="${p.id}">${p.next}</span></p></div></section><a class="link-button" href="${pRoute(p,'conversations')}">进入项目对话 →</a></div><div><section class="section-block"><h3>执行状态</h3><div class="simple-line">主线<span>${p.active?'运行中':'未运行'}</span></div><div class="simple-line">子代理<span data-agent-label="${p.id}">${p.subagents?'可用 · 当前 0 个':'关闭'}</span></div><div class="simple-line">后台验证<span>${p.id==='kanzei'?'1 项进行中':'无在途验证'}</span></div><p class="inline-note">${p.active?'离开本页后，项目继续推进。':'空闲项目只保留状态摘要。'}</p><button class="quiet" data-capabilities="${p.id}">管理项目能力 ↗</button></section><section class="section-block"><h3>待处理</h3><div class="simple-line">交付与决策<span>${reviews.filter(r=>r.project===p.id&&!r.done).length} 项</span></div><a class="link-button" href="#inbox/${p.id}">查看本项目待处理 →</a></section></div></div>;}` |
| [work](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:35>) | `function work(p){return <div class="section-head"><h2>在途与待办</h2><button class="quiet" data-new-goal="${p.id}">＋ 新目标</button></div><div class="work-detail">${requirement(p)}<p class="task-foot">${p.active?'负责线路：主线 · 运行中':'尚未领取'} · 实现、验证、试用分开查看</p></div>${p.goals.map(g=><div class="work-detail"><div class="req-meta">新目标 <span class="phase">待安排</span></div><h3>${escape(g)}</h3></div>).join('')}<p class="inline-note">工作持续保留；结束一次对话不会结束整个项目。</p>;}` |
| [chat](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:36>) | `function chat(p,requested){const c=p.conversations.find(c=>c.id===requested)\|\|p.conversations[0];const key=${p.id}/${c.id};return <div class="chat-layout"><nav class="chat-nav" aria-label="${p.name}的对话">${p.conversations.map(item=><button class="${item.id===c.id?'active':''}" data-chat="${p.id}/${item.id}">${escape(item.title)}</button>).join('')}<button class="new-chat" data-new-chat="${p.id}">＋ 新对话</button></nav><div class="chat-main"><div class="chat-head"><strong>${escape(c.title)}</strong><button class="link-button" data-detail="${p.id}">${p.work.id} ↗</button></div><div class="chat-log" aria-label="对话内容"><div class="message"><small>你</small><p>继续当前工作，记录决策，完成一批后交给我试用。</p></div><div class="message"><small>Kanzei · 示例回复</small><p>${p.id==='reader'?'附件保存与恢复已经形成可试用版本。接下来继续全文检索；真机 OCR 的设备缺口已单独记录，不影响这部分推进。':p.id==='kanzei'?'当前正在验证搜索与引用链路。相关选择已留在决策复核，项目进度会同步到工作台。':'项目目标和上次的工作记录已保留，安排下一项工作后继续。'}</p></div>${(messages.get(key)\|\|[]).map(m=><div class="message"><small>你 · 示例输入已记录</small><p>${escape(m)}</p></div>).join('')}</div><form class="composer" data-chat-form="${key}"><textarea name="message" aria-label="项目对话输入" placeholder="给这个项目补充说明…" required>${escape(drafts.get(key)\|\|'')}</textarea><div class="composer-footer"><span>${p.name} · 子代理${p.subagents?'可用':'关闭'}</span><button class="primary" type="submit">发送 ↑</button></div></form></div></div>;}` |
| [reviewRow](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:37>) | `function reviewRow(r){const p=project(r.project);return <article class="pending-row" data-review="${r.id}"><div class="pending-origin">${p.name} / ${p.work.id} · ${r.label}</div><h3>${r.title}</h3><p>${r.body}</p><details><summary>${r.kind==='delivery'?'查看交付说明':'查看选择理由'}</summary><p class="inline-note">${r.reason}</p></details><div data-review-body="${r.id}">${r.done?<p class="done-message">${escape(r.result)}</p>:r.kind==='delivery'?<div class="pending-actions"><button class="primary" data-accept="${r.id}">我已试用，通过</button><button class="quiet" data-delivery="${r.id}">查看示例成果</button></div>:<div class="pending-actions"><button data-accept="${r.id}">本次通过</button><button class="quiet" data-correct="${r.id}">纠正并反馈</button><a href="${pRoute(p,'conversations')}">进入原对话 ↗</a></div><div data-form-host="${r.id}"></div>}</div></article>;}` |
| [inbox](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:38>) | `function inbox(filter){const items=reviews.filter(r=>!filter\|\|r.project===filter);return <div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">REVIEW</div><h1>待我处理</h1><p>集中试用成果，复核那些替你做出的选择。</p></div><select class="filter" id="inbox-filter" aria-label="筛选待处理项目"><option value="">全部项目</option>${projects.map(p=><option value="${p.id}" ${filter===p.id?'selected':''}>${p.name}</option>).join('')}</select></div><p class="muted">本次通过只认可这次决定；纠正时可以选择记忆范围。</p>${items.length?items.map(reviewRow).join(''):'<p class="empty">这个项目暂时没有待处理事项。</p>'};}` |
| [preferencePage](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:39>) | `function preferencePage(){return <div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">PREFERENCES</div><h1>记忆与偏好</h1><p>保留已确认的习惯，并明确它们适用于哪里。</p></div></div>${preferences.map(p=><div class="preference-row"><small>${escape(p.scope)}</small><p>${escape(p.text)}</p><small>${p.source}</small></div>).join('')}<p class="inline-note">模型自己的决定不会自动成为你的全局偏好。图谱和更多管理工具在正式产品中按需进入。</p>;}` |
| [settings](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:40>) | `function settings(){return <div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SETTINGS</div><h1>设置</h1><p>全局默认提供起点，项目可以覆盖。</p></div></div><section class="section-block"><h3>执行预算 · 设计建议</h3><div class="simple-line">同时推进的项目<span>最多 2 个</span></div><div class="simple-line">每个项目的主执行线<span>默认 1 条</span></div><div class="simple-line">新项目子代理<span>默认关闭，按需开启</span></div><div class="simple-line">普通启动页面<span>工作台</span></div><p class="inline-note">这些是本原型的建议值。正式迁移保留用户已有设置，再用阅读器实验校准预算。</p></section>;}` |
| [render](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:41>) | `function render(){const hash=location.hash\|\|'#home';if(previousRoute)scrolls.set(previousRoute,window.scrollY);const parts=hash.slice(1).split('/');const p=project(parts[1]);let html,crumb='全局 / 工作台';if(parts[0]==='project'&&p){const tab=['overview','work','conversations'].includes(parts[2])?parts[2]:'overview';html=projectPage(p,tab,parts[3]);crumb=<a href="#home">工作台</a> / ${p.name};}else if(parts[0]==='inbox'){html=inbox(p?.id);crumb='全局 / 待我处理';}else if(parts[0]==='preferences'){html=preferencePage();crumb='全局 / 记忆与偏好';}else if(parts[0]==='settings'){html=settings();crumb='全局 / 设置';}else{html=home();}$('#main').innerHTML=html;$('#main').classList.remove('page-enter');void $('#main').offsetWidth;$('#main').classList.add('page-enter');$('#breadcrumb').innerHTML=crumb;document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(el=>{const active=el.dataset.nav===(parts[0]\|\|'home');el.classList.toggle('active',active);if(active)el.setAttribute('aria-current','page');else el.removeAttribute('aria-current');});document.querySelectorAll('[data-project-nav]').forEach(el=>{const active=parts[0]==='project'&&el.dataset.projectNav===p?.id;el.classList.toggle('active',active);if(active)el.setAttribute('aria-current','page');else el.removeAttribute('aria-current');});counts();previousRoute=hash;$('#main').focus({preventScroll:true});window.scrollTo(0,scrolls.get(hash)\|\|0);}` |
| [showDetail](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:42>) | `function showDetail(p){$('#detail-content').innerHTML=<div class="eyebrow">${p.name} / ${p.work.id}</div><h2 id="detail-title">${p.work.title}</h2>${meter(p)}<p class="muted">已完成批次，不代表用户验收。</p><ul class="info-list"><li><span>业务状态</span>${p.work.status} · ${p.work.priority}</li><li><span>当前阶段</span><span data-next="${p.id}" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--ink)">${p.next}</span></li><li><span>机器验证</span>${p.id==='reader'?'当前交付版本通过；OCR未验证':p.id==='kanzei'?'搜索链路验证中':'尚未开始'}</li><li><span>用户试用</span>${p.id==='reader'?(reviews.find(r=>r.id==='delivery-reader').done?'本次已认可':'附件保存与恢复待试用'):'暂无新交付'}</li><li><span>归属</span>${p.name} / ${p.active?'主线':'未领取'}</li></ul><h3>下一步</h3><p class="muted">${p.note}</p><div class="form-actions"><a href="${pRoute(p,'work')}" class="link-button" data-close-detail>进入项目工作 →</a></div>;$('#detail').showModal();}` |
| [capabilities](<C:/Users/kanzei/Documents/kanzei code/docs/prototypes/workbench/workbench.js:43>) | `function capabilities(p){$('#detail-content').innerHTML=<div class="eyebrow">${p.name}</div><h2 id="detail-title">项目能力</h2><p class="muted">需要时开启，状态归属于当前项目。</p><div class="simple-line">子代理<button class="toggle ${p.subagents?'on':''}" role="switch" aria-checked="${p.subagents}" aria-label="${p.name}子代理" data-toggle-agent="${p.id}">${p.subagents?'已开启':'已关闭'}</button></div><p class="inline-note">全局默认关闭；${p.subagents?'本项目已覆盖为开启':'本项目当前关闭'}。当前运行 0 个。</p><p class="muted">关闭后不再派发新的子代理；已运行的子代理继续收尾，停止在途任务使用单独动作。</p><h3>按需打开</h3><ul class="info-list"><li>文件、差异与预览</li><li>研究与远端实验</li><li>记忆图谱与运行画像</li></ul><p class="muted">这些能力收进项目工具；不在工作台持续加载。本原型仅演示子代理开关。</p>;$('#detail').showModal();}` |
